California’s sea level just hit its HIGHEST level ever measured at 7 NOAA tide gauges...

Los Angeles, with records back to 1923, averaged 6.5 inches above its old record month (September 2015) in October.  San Francisco beat its record from the 1998 El Niño. 

Near-shore water https://t.co/NzOCm6OCX2

Omaha tied a record high of 75° today, and by Thursday night it’s forecast to drop to 29°...

That’s a 46-degree swing in just a few days. It would also be Omaha’s first freeze of the season, and if it happens Thursday night, it ties the LATEST first freeze on record there. https://t.co/QV8OKFXb7k

Only 1.9% of the Lower 48 has snow on the ground right now...

On this date, that’s normally closer to 10%. The only year since 2003 with less snow cover this early in November was 2016. 

The Rockies are almost completely bare, and spots like Denver, Cheyenne and Duluth are https://t.co/CsimY9xURY

There's been a lot of talk about a potential Northeast snowstorm this week, but for most people, this is going to be a rain event...

The real snow stays in the mountains and the interior, while New York, Philly and Boston just get a chilly rain. https://t.co/MUtpQh7qZs

Thunderstorms are likely on Wednesday across parts of the Midwest and Southeast. Isolated hail is possible. The tornado threat is very low.
